summary: July core CPI came in at 2.6%, below the 2.8% forecast, and falling gasoline and energy costs helped keep overall consumer price increases in check. The cooler-than-expected inflation print reinforced the case for the Fed to hold, pressuring the dollar and amplifying gold's run.
tweet: July CPI undershot forecasts, cementing a Fed hold and hammering the dollar. New 50% Canada tariffs kicking in Tuesday add a fresh trade jolt to an already risk-on week.
